description: Repro (base binary): `with n when n > 0 <- 5 do n end` gives an internal error: "unsupported quoted pattern head `when`". Elixir allows a guard on a with clause's pattern. Done when: an oracle fixture with a guard that passes and one that falls through to else agrees on interp, run and build, and the guard follows the same macro-in-guard rule as other guards.
title: A guarded with clause `with n when n > 0 <- x` works, as in Elixir
